screening.summary: Hospital diet choice depends on nutritional risk assessment at admission.

reassessment.summary: Hospital nutrition should be checked, re-evaluated, and adapted every 3-5 days according to disease course, monitored oral intake, and patient acceptance.

therapeuticDietUse.summary: Therapeutic diets should only be used if medically indicated because they increase risk for malnutrition. Intake must be monitored; if dietary modifications are insufficient, provide medical nutrition support.

defaultDiet.summary: Hospitalized patients without or at low nutritional risk and without special diet requirements should receive the standard diet.

kidneyHospitalizationOverride.summary: CKD patients previously on controlled protein intake should not remain on that low-protein regimen during hospitalization if acute illness caused admission.

hospitalMenuGovernance.summary: Hospital diet lists should be visible, and hospital food diets should be re-evaluated every 3-5 years according to new nutrition and medical evidence.
